What it does

Three ways to run it

In the browser

Open the live demo — nothing to install.

As an app

The Windows .exe and the Android .apk are portable: no installer, no admin rights. There is also a Linux binary in the release.

From the source

It is one HTML file. Download it, open it, done — there is no build step.

Privacy

Everything stays on your device. There is no server, no account, and the page forbids outbound requests, so there is nowhere for your data to go.
